item.title: Sabalenka beats Svitolina to reach fourth straight Australian Open final
item.description: MELBOURNE, Australia (AP) — Not even a point penalty for hindrance slowed Aryna Sabalenka's run to a fourth consecutive Australian Open final.

item.title: Construction sector's GDP rises, but still facing tariff, labour challenges: report
item.description: Canada's construction sector generated growth in its most recent quarter but continues to face rising costs, especially due to ongoing tariffs.

item.title: Poulin ready for Olympics following Victoire's 3-0 win over Sceptres
item.description: LAVAL — Marie-Philip Poulin is heading to her fifth Olympic Games under different circumstances from her previous four.

item.title: Some blind fans to experience Super Bowl with tactile device that tracks ball
item.description: Some blind and low-vision fans will have unprecedented access to the Super Bowl thanks to a tactile device that tracks the ball, vibrates on key plays and provides real-time audio.

item.title: Starmer and Xi call for deeper UK-China ties as Trump shakes up global relations
item.description: BEIJING (AP) — The leaders of Britain and China called Thursday for a "strategic partnership” to deepen ties between their nations at a time of growing global turbulence as they sought to thaw relations after years of chill.

item.title: Charge get 'needed' three points ahead of Olympic break thanks to clutch play
item.description: OTTAWA — The Ottawa Charge needed a win, and they found an extra gear late to get the job done.

item.title: 11 dead in minibus and truck collision in South Africa days after a similar crash killed 14 children
item.description: JOHANNESBURG (AP) — A collision involving a minibus taxi and a truck killed at least 11 people in South Africa on Thursday, a local government official and emergency services said, just over a week after a similar road crash left 14 schoolchildren
